Subject: Need help with a cross-border insolvency case

Hello, my name is Mary Iyer. I am a 44-year-old dentist living in New Delhi. Our company is owed Rs 56,03,00,000 by Naidu Holdings Ltd, which is insolvent here and abroad, and the foreign administrator wants control of the assets in this country. My case number is C.P.(IB) No. 2543/2023 in the NCLT Mumbai. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 81833 34288 or email mary.iyer9@example.in.
